basic_details.job_title: Tamil University Guest Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.department: İsaiturrai (Department of Music), Kalvettiyal mattum Tolliyal Turrai (Department of Epigraphy and Archaeology), Kalviyiyal mattum Elangilam Melānmaiyiyal Turrai (Department of Education and English Management)

qualification.details: post: Qualification | guest assistant professor (music - vocal): 1) Post Graduate degree in Music discipline with 55% marks. 2) PASS in NET or SET test. /Or/ 3) Ph.D. degree in Music. | guest assistant professor (music - bharatanatyam): 1) Post Graduate degree in Bharatanatyam discipline with 55% marks. 2) PASS in NET or SET test. /Or/ 3) Ph.D. degree in Bharatanatyam. | guest assistant professor (epigraphy and archaeology - archaeology): 1) Post Graduate degree in History and Archaeology / Ancient History and Archaeology discipline with 55% marks. 2) SET / NET test pass as per university syndicate rules. /Or/ 3) Ph.D. degree in History and Archaeology.
qualification.education_qualification: 1) Post Graduate degree in English (English) with 55% marks. 2) Post Graduate degree in Education (M.Ed. / M.A Education) with 55% marks. 3) NET / SLET test pass. /Or/ 4) Ph.D. degree - Education or English.

how_to_apply: Download the application form from the official website (www.tamiluniversity.ac.in).
Fill out the application form completely with all required details.
Enclose self-attested copies of educational qualifications, community certificate, and other supporting certificates.
Obtain a demand draft (DD) for application fees drawn in favour of "Registrar, Tamil University, Thanjavur" payable at Thanjavur (Rs. 200/- for General category, Rs. 100/- for Scheduled categories).
Send the completed application form along with all enclosures and DD by post to reach the office of the Registrar on or before 29 October 2026 by 5.00 PM.
important_instructions: The appointment is completely temporary, and permanent appointment cannot be claimed. Applications received without copies of educational qualifications, community certificate, and other testimonials will be rejected without notice. Tamil University syndicate reserves the right to alter or cancel this notification at any time without prior notice. If the work of the guest assistant professor is not satisfactory, they may be released from duty at any time. Only candidates with NET/SLET/Ph.D. (Awarded) in the specified subjects may participate. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Applications must reach the Registrar's office by 29 October 2026, 5.00 PM. Applications received after the deadline will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly remuneration for each Guest Assistant Professor post is Rs. 30,000/- only. The appointment is entirely temporary (tharkālikam), and permanent appointment cannot be claimed based on this. The university syndicate rules (UGC Regulations) apply to educational qualifications. Tamil Nadu government's 200 point roster reservation system is followed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Tamil University Guest Assistant Professor
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website (www.tamiluniversity.ac.in). Fill out the application form completely with all required details. Enclose self-attested copies of educational qualifications, community certificate, and other supporting certificates. Obtain a demand draft (DD) for application fees drawn in favour of "Registrar, Tamil University, Thanjavur" payable at Thanjavur (Rs. 200/- for General category, Rs. 100/- for Scheduled categories). Send the completed application form along with all enclosures and DD by post to reach the office of the Registrar on or before 29 October 2026 by 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced in Tamil University Guest Assistant Professor recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 4 temporary vacancies have been announced for Guest Assistant Professor posts across Music, Epigraphy and Archaeology, and Education and Management departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Tamil University Guest Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date for applications to reach the Registrar's office is 29 October 2026 by 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary for Tamil University Guest Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 30,000/- only.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for Tamil University recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 200/- for General category candidates and Rs. 100/- for Scheduled category candidates, payable via demand draft in favour of "Registrar, Tamil University, Thanjavur".

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required for the English post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree in English with 55% marks, a Post Graduate degree in Education (M.Ed. / M.A Education) with 55% marks, along with NET/SLET test pass or a Ph.D. in Education or English.

faq.question: Q6. How should I submit my application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by downloading the form from the university website, filling it, attaching self-attested certificate copies and the demand draft, and sending it by post to the Registrar, Tamil University, Thanjavur.

faq.question: Q7. Are these posts permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: These appointments are entirely temporary, and permanent appointment cannot be claimed.

faq.question: Q8. Is there a written examination for selection?
faq.answer: The notification states that selection involves scrutiny of applications and an interview, with no travel allowance provided for interview participants.
